messages:
Cecilia: Morning! First day here — thanks for having me :wave: I got an M3 MBP but hitting a roadblock. Trying to enroll in Kandji but our corporate Wi‑Fi uses a proxy with client certs and the enrollment HTTP request returns 403. Also FileVault status says 'On' but I don't see an escrowed recovery key in 1Password. Can I get temporary admin to install Docker & Homebrew while we sort this? @Alex any pointers?

Alex: Welcome, Cecilia — congrats and welcome aboard! Quick wins: 1) can you DM me the serial and primary Wi‑Fi MAC? 2) try tethering to your phone or join the office guest network (no client cert) and re-run enrollment. Also paste the output of `profiles status -type enrollment`.

Cecilia: Pasted serial via DM. Ran the profile check: `profiles status -type enrollment` -> `No enrolled profiles found` and `Enrollment: Failed (HTTP 403)`. Guest network isn't available from home, I'm remote. Tether worked briefly but enrollment still fails after the redirect.

Marisa: Hi Cecilia — security note: we can't approve permanent admin until FileVault escrow is confirmed. We can escrow a recovery key from Kandji if the device finishes enrollment or if you run `sudo fdesetup changerecovery -personal` and share the generated key with us via 1Password secure note. Would prefer Kandji escrow to avoid manual keys.

Alex: Ok — two paths. A) I can push a one-off temporary enrollment profile that only handles escrow & bypasses the proxy check; that'll allow Kandji to escrow your FV key and complete enrollment. B) If you need Docker now, I can grant a temporary admin account for 6 hours so you can install Homebrew/Docker and then we revoke. Which do you prefer?

Cecilia: Temp admin for a few hours would unblock my setup today. If we can also get the escrow done in the background, that'd be perfect.

Alex: Done — added you to the 'temp-admins' Okta group for 6 hours. You should get a notification; log out and back in. After you install, run `sudo fdesetup status` and paste the result so Marisa can verify escrow.

Cecilia: Got the Okta prompt, back in. Installed Homebrew & Docker. `sudo fdesetup status` -> `FileVault is On.`

Marisa: Thanks — I see the escrow in Kandji now, recovery key recorded. We'll mark this device as compliant. FYI, Alex, please revoke temp-admin in 6 hours from now.

Alex: Will do. Cecilia — if anything else pops up (kernel extensions or permissions), ping me here or open an IT ticket. Enjoy your first week :tada:
